english.title: Failed to replace lost or illegible tag within 28 days on an animal born in Wales before 1 January 1998
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the keeper of an animal born in Great Britain before 1 January 1998, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), and having discovered that an ear tag had become illegible or had been lost, failed to either re-tag it with another single tag or re-tag it with double tags in accordance with the Cattle Identification (Wales) Regulations 2007, within 28 days of the discovery
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 15 of, and paragraph 4(3) of Schedule 1 to, the Cattle Identification (Wales) Regulations 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the keeper of an animal born in Great Britain before 1 January 1998
having discovered that an ear tag had become illegible or had been lost
failed to retag the animal/s
within 28 days
